answer.question: What is Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: Icanio Tech School is the education arm of Icanio Technologies, a Tamil Nadu based AI and software company trusted by 100+ businesses. It runs tech internships in 15 tracks, a Student Development Program, hands-on workshops and MoU programs for colleges. Every session is led by practising Icanio engineers, and students work on briefs taken from real client projects.

sections.heading: Tech internships that lead to careers
Choose the path that fits you
sections.intro: Tell us who you are and we will show you the right next step. Most students start with tech internships. Colleges usually start with an MoU.

items.title: I am a student or fresher
items.body: Pick one of 15 tech internships, from frontend development to finance. You join a live project team, get a mentor and finish with a certificate and a portfolio.

items.title: I want job-ready soft skills
items.body: The Student Development Program builds the nine workplace skills that decide whether a capable engineer does well in the first job: communication, teamwork, time and more.

sections.heading: Tech internships for engineering and non-engineering students
sections.intro: Our tech internships follow the same tools and workflows our delivery teams use. Choose a track, then choose a duration of up to six months.

items.title: Frontend Development
items.body: Build responsive interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and TypeScript, then deploy them.

items.title: Backend Development
items.body: Design APIs, databases and server logic, and learn how production services are tested and shipped.

items.title: Full Stack Development
items.body: Take a web product from interface to database to deployment on one end-to-end project.

items.title: Software Testing
items.body: Learn manual and automation testing, write test cases and report defects the way QA teams do.

items.title: AI & ML
items.body: Clean real datasets, train machine learning models and evaluate them on practical problems.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.body: Go from user research to wireframes to clickable prototypes in Figma on real product briefs.

items.title: DevOps
items.body: Automate builds, deployments and infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines, containers and cloud.

items.title: Flutter App Development
items.body: Create cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, from screen design to store-ready builds.

items.title: Business Analyst
items.body: Gather requirements, map processes and write the documents that guide delivery teams.

items.title: Project Management
items.body: Plan sprints, track delivery and coordinate people from kickoff to release.

items.title: Data Analyst
items.body: Turn raw data into dashboards and insights with Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.body: Run live campaigns across content, social media, SEO and ads, and measure what works.

items.title: Human Resource
items.body: Work on recruitment, onboarding and employee engagement tasks inside a real company.

items.title: Finance
items.body: Practise budgeting, reporting and financial analysis on live business data.

items.title: Sales
items.body: Learn lead generation, client communication and closing through real market interactions.

sections.heading: How tech internships at Icanio work, step by step
sections.intro: Five steps take you from application to a verified certificate. Our team stays with you at each one.

items.title: Apply and talk to a counsellor
items.body: Send the short form. Our team calls you within one working day to understand your goal, year of study and preferred start date.
items.label: Step 1

items.title: Pick your track and duration
items.body: Choose one of our 15 tech internships and a duration from 15 days to six months, offline, online or part time.
items.label: Step 2

items.title: Learn in phases with a mentor
items.body: Each track moves through structured phases. A working engineer reviews your code or deliverables every week.
items.label: Step 3

items.title: Ship a live project
items.body: You work on a brief derived from Icanio client scenarios, in sprints, with the same review standards as our internal teams.
items.label: Step 4

items.title: Get certified and referred
items.body: Finish with a certificate, a portfolio review and interview practice. Top performers are referred to the Icanio talent team.
items.label: Finish

sections.heading: Learn from engineers who build real products
sections.intro: Our trainers are not full-time lecturers. They are engineers, architects and product managers on active Icanio client projects.
paragraphs: Icanio Technologies builds AI, cloud, data and software systems for more than 100 businesses. Icanio Tech School brings that same expertise into structured learning. The person reviewing your pull request is someone who reviews pull requests for clients every week.

That changes what tech internships teach you. You pick up production coding habits, not just syntax. You see how architecture decisions are made, how agile teams run a sprint and what hiring managers actually screen for. Curriculum is written by Icanio engineers from live project experience and refreshed every cohort.

In our experience, the students who get hired fastest are not the ones with the most certificates. They are the ones who can explain a real project they built, the trade-offs they made and what they would do differently. Our tech internships are designed to give you exactly that story.
bullets: Every trainer in our tech internships has 3+ years of client delivery experience
Code reviews follow internal Icanio standards
Trainers are background verified by Icanio HR
Student feedback is reviewed every cohort

sections.note: We recommend tech internships in your pre-final or final year, when you can apply the fundamentals you already know to a real project.

sections.heading: Student Development Program and Hands-On Workshops
paragraphs: Most campus training focuses on technical skills alone. Many graduates then struggle in the first IT job, not because they cannot code, but because they are not ready for a stand-up, a sprint deadline or a client call.

Our Student Development Program fixes that with nine modules built on real IT workplace scenarios, from professional communication to leadership in technology roles. Alongside tech internships, our workshops add short, practical exposure to emerging technologies, from half-day sessions to multi-day formats.
bullets: Nine soft skill modules taught through IT workplace scenarios
Workshops in Python, web development, data science, AI and more
Interview preparation and career roadmap planning

faqs.q: What tech internships does Icanio Tech School offer?
faqs.a: We offer 15 tech internships. Engineering tracks are Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, Software Testing, AI & ML, UI/UX, DevOps, Flutter, Business Analyst and Project Management. Non-engineering tracks are Data Analyst, Digital Marketing, Human Resource, Finance and Sales.

faqs.q: Who can apply for tech internships at Icanio?
faqs.a: College students in any year, recent graduates, self-taught learners and career switchers can apply. Most interns are in their pre-final or final year of B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, MCA or MBA. Our team will suggest a track based on your background.

faqs.q: How long are the tech internships?
faqs.a: You choose the duration. Options range from 15 days and one month up to three and six months. Longer internships include more phases and a larger live project, which gives you a stronger portfolio.

faqs.q: Are tech internships offline or online?
faqs.a: Both. You can attend offline at our centre, join online, or choose part-time weekday or weekend batches. Hybrid is also possible, so the internship fits around your college schedule.

faqs.q: Do I get a certificate after the internship?
faqs.a: Yes. Every intern who completes one of our tech internships receives an Icanio Tech School certificate that states the track and duration. You also leave with a portfolio of the projects you built.

We run resume building, mock interviews and LinkedIn workshops for every intern. Top performers are referred to the Icanio Technologies talent team for internship and associate roles, as happened with our SDE hire Jeyaram R.

faqs.q: How can my college partner with Icanio Tech School?
faqs.a: Colleges usually start with an MoU. It gives students priority access to workshops, value added courses and sponsored internships, and faculty access to development programs. Send an enquiry and our team will visit or call.

faqs.q: Where is Icanio Tech School located?
faqs.a: We are part of Icanio Technologies, headquartered in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu. Programs run at our centre, online, and on partner college campuses across the state, from Chennai and Coimbatore to Erode and Kanyakumari.

takeaways: Icanio Tech School is the education arm of Icanio Technologies, an AI and software company in Tamil Nadu.
It offers 15 tech internships across engineering and non-engineering tracks, from 15 days to six months.
Trainers are practising Icanio engineers, and every intern works on a brief from real client scenarios.
Interns finish with a certificate, a portfolio and interview preparation, and top performers are referred to Icanio.
Over 30 colleges partner through an MoU for value added courses, guest lectures, FDPs and industrial visits.
conclusion: A degree tells employers what you studied. A real project tells them what you can do. Our tech internships exist to give every student that second proof, guided by engineers who do this work every day.

Whether you are a student choosing between tech internships or a college planning the next semester, the next step is the same: talk to our team. We will help you choose the right track or program, and you can start within weeks.
